The College of Emerging and Integrative Studies offers a dynamic and innovative approach to education, seamlessly blending science, humanities, business, and technology. Our diverse range of programs empowers students to customize their academic journey to create a path
that aligns with their personal interests and career aspirations. Whether pursuing
an undergraduate, master’s, or doctoral degree, online or in-person, we are dedicated to providing a comprehensive academic experience that prepares students for success
in the future.
Interdisciplinary Studies
Professional Studies
Environmental and Sustainability Studies
Communication and Media
About Our Programs
The School of Interdisciplinary Studies offers students the opportunity to emphasize not one but two program areas of interest,
and merge them to create their own degree according to their personal interests.
The School of Professional Studies provides a wide range of career-advancing, flexible degrees designed to fit into
students' busy lives and offered completely online.
The School of Environmental Studies equips students with a deep understanding of the dynamics of the natural world and
empowers them to tackle complex environmental challenges.
The Department of Communication and Media's concentration paths, Journalism and Communication Studies, provide students opportunities
to learn skills directly related to various media fields and gain hands-on experience
to build their portfolio.

CEIS Alumni
The Interdisciplinary Studies program is a true asset to Tennessee Tech, and I hope
to see it continue to grow and be supported by the university. I'd like to encourage
CEIS alumni to stay connected and give back in support of the program and its current
students.
This experience is amazing, and achieving professional career goals begins with this
rather brief part of the journey. The foundation established through academic coursework
at the College of Emerging and Integrative Studies leads to a path that is rewarding
and filled with meaningful accomplishment.
CEIS Alum Jim Fry
Interdisciplinary studies saved me from my indecisive freshman and sophomore years,
letting me graduate with the credits I had in place. I recommend to anyone who had
a drastic major change (or 6, like me) to investigate interdisciplinary studies!
One of the greatest strengths of an interdisciplinary background is adaptability.
Developing a diverse skill set will allow you to take on new challenges, pivot when
needed, and explore different career paths.
CEIS Alum Hailey Loeffler
Excellent program. I was already working in technical education and wanted to tailor
my degree to match my career. The staff seemed to know exactly what I wanted to do
and worked with other colleges within the university to customize a degree that perfectly
matched my educational needs.
Embrace the versatility of your degree! Interdisciplinary studies allow you to shape
your education in a way that aligns with your passions.
CEIS Alum Ashley Martin
The College of Emerging and Integrative Studies is one of the most unique and dynamic
departments on Tech’s campus. There is so much more to it than most students realize,
including the opportunity to design your own degree and explore a variety of innovative
master’s programs.
CEIS Master's Student Lilly Davis
